original_owner.empty_behavior: No feature rows -> returns empty before DDL/write (111-128). Errors must not become VERIFIED_EMPTY.
original_owner.write_behavior: Nonempty -> missing-only ensure_table_exists(force=False) then original questdb_client.write_model; returned frame/row count alone does not verify ACK.
original_owner.mode_warning: Original entry accepts only start_month/end_month. Generic catalog signature-filter can silently drop --no-write/full/force; do not invoke build as a read-only oracle.

python_lineage.pivot: Original ordered dates -> pivot_table aggfunc=last with skipna=True, no fill; Java takes last finite non-null pct_chg in each code/month. A later NULL does not erase an earlier value.
python_lineage.duplicate_keys: Reject all (ts_code,trade_date) duplicates; original non-deduplicating source has no deterministic tie breaker.
python_lineage.unit_decision: Preserve stored index_monthly.pct_chg unchanged; all 13 spreads are differences in those same stored units. No divide100, multiply100, close-return recomputation or rounding.
python_lineage.legacy_unit_declaration: Python source-model comment and previous D022/source-contract metadata say percent. Actual captured provider JSON and stored source are ratio-like; ratio diagnostics are not a universal semantic-unit certification. D022 semantics outside D103 were not changed.
python_lineage.code_conflict: Preserve legacy value=000920.SH and growth=000921.SH; preserve growth(921)-value(920). Do not silently replace with index-universe names.
python_lineage.ui_scaling: Existing UI multiplication by100 is consumer display behavior, not mapper/materializer scaling.

bounded_source.job_window: First-day LocalDate from/to inclusive, 1..12 months; SQL uses exclusive next month boundary
bounded_source.raw_hash: All fourteen ordered typed values and full source keys, explicit NULLs, both timestamp micros carriers, all nine DOUBLE raw bits; includes fields not used in pct_chg formula.
bounded_source.checks: Source vector and all14 raw fingerprint frozen at plan; re-read around preflight/fetch/send/readback/WAL and final full-prefix verification.

mode_admission.closed_months_all_modes: to month must precede YearMonth(logicalDate); reject current/future months before send.
mode_admission.MATERIALIZE: Retain legacy historical nullable cells/omitted entirely empty months, subject to finite bounded source/global required-code availability. Whole-window emptiness never advances checkpoint.
mode_admission.INCREMENTAL: Every anchor..to month must be continuous with all16 direct source cells finite/non-null. Missing month/code/all-null code-month rejects before send.
mode_admission.RECONCILE: Bounded readonly comparison of frozen source-derived full-prefix targets; no publisher send.
mode_admission.historical_read: 29 finite nullable DOUBLE cells may be NULL, including all-null historical records; this is not source readiness.
mode_admission.prepared_write: 1..12 unique months, <=1MiB, typed finite nullable cells; a timestamp-only all29-NULL record is rejected.

read_and_cursor.range: month first-day LocalDate from inclusive/to exclusive, 1..12 months
read_and_cursor.version_checks: Before and after schema/row reads; cursor fingerprint binds physical token plus request and last complete month key. Reject a stale token before row query.
read_and_cursor.empty_new_table: Null physical txn retained as uninitialized, accepted only independently COUNT0, writer/seq/pending/buffer0, raw wal_txn/raw rowcount null or0 and unchanged raw metadata around COUNT. Never coerce null txn to0.
read_and_cursor.purpose: Physical read stability and historical integrity; no provider-currentness or full-history claim.

same bootstrap anchor and candidate range within new bounded range
original durable FETCHED page fingerprint and full-prefix evidence
old expected prefix is closed/continuous and16 direct non-null cells per month

checkpoint_and_verification.source_prefix_unchanged: Recompute old all14 raw fingerprint and29 derived values; if unchanged and only appended source, start at old checkpoint month itself for one-month overlap. Record VERIFIED_PREFIX_APPEND and parent/source version.
checkpoint_and_verification.source_prefix_revised: Any old raw14 or derived change, or source identity/schema change -> rebuild bounded bootstrap <=12 months. Record SOURCE_PREFIX_REVISED.
checkpoint_and_verification.target_prefix_drift: Reject, rather than silently regenerate a checkpoint from drifted targets.
checkpoint_and_verification.page_fingerprint: SHA256(SHA256(source_version + newline + source_hash) + newline + from + newline + to)
checkpoint_and_verification.verification: Exact full month keys, NULL bitmap and DOUBLE raw bits; zero tolerance. Full anchor..to target readback, stable settled target and final same source proof occur inside adapter.fetch before shared runner can mark VERIFIED.
checkpoint_and_verification.revision_evidence: Pure tests cover source-only raw-field revisions, closed/continuous-prefix reuse, source changes, target drift and empty cases; actual August increment not yet accepted at this document cutoff.
